verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an LLM runtime with a REST API, for example batch requests or multi-item operations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk or batch capability. Running multiple models concurrently and sustaining throughput across several agents are concurrency features, not bulk operations across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
